NAME: PWM verification plan
details: Block 20: garuda_pwm_top with garuda_pwm_core and the APB shim. Source: GARUDA-PWM-SPEC-001. These pins drive motor controllers, so a glitch is a safety event. Feature-level plan written 2026-10-04, before the UVM environment. Sign-off criteria: flow/0_signoff_criteria.md.

NAME: A Registers
details: APB window 8, 0x4000_8000. Spec section 6.

NAME: F01 PRESCALE sets the tick
details: Offset 0x00, read-write, reset 0. Bits 15:0; one tick is PRESCALE + 1 pclk cycles. Bits 31:16 read 0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-4] read-back, [R-8] at 9 and 0xFFFF. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access PRESCALE
details: Reset value, read-back, upper bits read 0.
implementation_note: pwm_reg_test in tb/pwm/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/pwm.rdl). Passing.

NAME: F02 PERIOD sets the frame length in ticks
details: Offset 0x04, read-write, reset 0. Bits 15:0.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-4], [R-8] PERIOD 0xFFFF. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access PERIOD
details: Reset value, read-back, upper bits read 0.
implementation_note: pwm_reg_test in tb/pwm/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/pwm.rdl). Passing.

NAME: F03 CTRL holds the master enable and four channel enables
details: Offset 0x08, read-write, reset 0. Bit 0 EN, bits 7:4 one enable per channel, all other bits read 0. Spec [N-6.1].
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [N-6.1]. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: ral_access CTRL
details: Reset value, read-back of bits 0 and 7:4, the rest read 0.
implementation_note: pwm_reg_test in tb/pwm/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/pwm.rdl). Passing.

NAME: cg_pwm_ctrl.x_en_chen
details: Every value of the four channel enables with EN 0 and 1.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F04 STATUS shows the live counter and the clamp flags
details: Offset 0x0C, read-only. Bits 15:0 the counter, bits 19:16 one clamp flag per channel. A write is ignored and raises no error - the specification asks for none (the policy differs between blocks, BUGS.md AUD-13).
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm reads the clamp flags. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: sb_status
details: Counter and clamp bits compared with the reference model at each read.
implementation_note: pwm_scoreboard in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv, against pwm_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs.

NAME: F05 DUTY0 to DUTY3 hold the pulse width in ticks
details: Offsets 0x10 to 0x1C, read-write, reset 0, bits 15:0. A read returns the value written, not the shadow.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-4]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_access DUTY
details: Reset value, read-back, no aliasing between the four.
implementation_note: pwm_reg_test in tb/pwm/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/pwm.rdl). Passing.

NAME: F06 IRQSTAT IRQEN DMACTL and ID in the shim
details: Offsets 0xFE0 to 0xFEC. IRQSTAT is write-1-to-clear with bit 0 the period boundary and bit 1 a clamped duty; IRQEN masks; DMACTL is read-write and has no effect because PWM has no DMA channel; ID reads 0x6A5D, block 20 and the revision.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm reads ID and uses IRQSTAT bit 1. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: ral_access shim
details: Access policy of the four shim registers.
implementation_note: pwm_reg_test in tb/pwm/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/pwm.rdl). Passing.

NAME: a_no_dma_req
details: PWM never raises a DMA request whatever DMACTL holds.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger.

NAME: F07 Unmapped offsets raise PSLVERR and change nothing
details: 0x20 to 0xFDC, 0xFF0 and above, and unaligned offsets, on reads and writes. A write to STATUS or ID is ignored without an error (BUGS.md AUD-13). An unaligned offset inside 0x00 to 0x1F is not driven - the bridge issues none - and the shim would answer it without an error.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm - one unmapped offset. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: sb_pslverr
details: PSLVERR compared with the model's address map on every access.
implementation_note: pwm_scoreboard in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv, against pwm_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs.

NAME: cg_pwm_apb.x_unmapped_rw
details: Between the two mapped ranges, the first offset past each, above the shim registers, unaligned offsets in the shim range, and an alias of every register, each read and written.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F08 Accesses never wait
details: PREADY is high in every cycle. Requirement R-4.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-4]; the APB protocol checker is bound - 0 violations. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: a_pready
details: pready_o is 1 in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA a_shim_pready in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the shim of every peripheral. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, six block benches and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: apb_checker
details: Ten APB protocol rules and 0 violations.
implementation_note: tb/common/apb_checker.v, bound in tb_pwm_uvm and tb_pwm. 0 violations in 22 runs.

NAME: F09 Reset values
details: Every register 0 and all four outputs low after preset_n.
implementation_note: Method: sim (register model). Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [N-9.2]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: ral_reset
details: Register model reset test.
implementation_note: pwm_reg_test in tb/pwm/uvm (register model generated from Design_Docs/regs/pwm.rdl). Passing.

NAME: B The waveform
details: Spec 7.1, 7.2. Every width is measured on the pin.

NAME: F10 Pulse width equals DUTY ticks and the frame equals PERIOD ticks
details: To one tick, for any PRESCALE. Requirement R-1, R-8.
implementation_note: Method: sim (scoreboard measuring the pins) + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-1] four widths, the 50 Hz servo case, [R-8] two prescale values. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: sb_pulse
details: A monitor measures every high time and every period on each pin in pclk cycles and compares with the model.
implementation_note: pwm_scoreboard, measured on the pins without the model's cycle state - 41363 frames and 38176 pulses in 22 runs, 0 mismatches.

NAME: cg_pwm_cfg.x_prescale_period_duty
details: PRESCALE 0, 1, mid, 0xFFFF; PERIOD 1, 2, mid, 0xFFFF; DUTY 0, 1, mid, PERIOD minus 1, PERIOD. PRESCALE 0xFFFF with PERIOD 0xFFFF is a frame of 4e9 cycles and is excluded in the covergroup with that reason.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F11 DUTY 0 is never high and DUTY equal to PERIOD is always high
details: No pulse at 0; at 100 percent the line does not drop at the frame boundary.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm edge widths DUTY 1, PERIOD minus 1, 0, and DUTY = PERIOD = 0xFFFF. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: a_duty0_low
details: A channel whose shadow duty is 0 is low for the whole frame.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_duty_full_high
details: A channel whose shadow duty equals PERIOD has no falling edge at the boundary.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger.

NAME: F12 The four channels are independent
details: Each has its own duty and its own enable; changing one leaves the other three unchanged. Requirement R-2.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-2]. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: sb_pulse
details: Per-pin model compare.
implementation_note: pwm_scoreboard, measured on the pins without the model's cycle state - 41363 frames and 38176 pulses in 22 runs, 0 mismatches.

NAME: cg_pwm_ch.cp_duty_order
details: Each of the 24 orderings of the four duties at least once; two and three channels with equal duty.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F13 All four rising edges are in the same cycle
details: One prescaler and one counter, so no register value can skew them. Requirement R-3, spec [N-7.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-3], [N-7.2]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: a_aligned
details: In a cycle in which any enabled channel with non-zero duty rises, every such channel is high.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F14 Corner values of PERIOD and PRESCALE
details: PERIOD 0 and 1, PRESCALE 0xFFFF, PERIOD 0xFFFF (the 17-bit compare of PWM-1).
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm PERIOD 0xFFFF frame. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: cg_pwm_cfg.cp_period_corner
details: PERIOD 0, 1, 0xFFFE, 0xFFFF with EN set.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: a_counter_bound
details: The counter is always below PERIOD when PERIOD is not 0.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: C Double buffering
details: Spec 7.3. The requirement that shapes the design.

NAME: F15 A duty written mid-pulse never shortens the pulse in progress
details: The write lands in a holding register and reaches the shadow only at the period boundary. Requirement R-5, spec [N-7.3].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-5], [N-7.3]. Now: all 3 items passing.

NAME: a_shadow_only_at_boundary
details: A shadow duty changes only in the boundary cycle.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: sb_no_runt
details: No high time on any pin is shorter than both the old and the new duty.
implementation_note: pwm_scoreboard, measured on the pins without the model's cycle state - 41363 frames and 38176 pulses in 22 runs, 0 mismatches.

NAME: cg_pwm_dbuf.x_when_old_new
details: Write placed before the falling edge, after it, in the boundary cycle and one cycle either side; new duty shorter and longer than the old.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F16 Duties written across a boundary
details: Firmware writes four registers one after another. If the boundary falls between them, two channels change one frame before the other two. The specification does not say whether that is acceptable; to be decided and written down.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: no check. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: cg_pwm_dbuf.cp_split_update
details: A boundary between the first and the last of four consecutive duty writes.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F17 PRESCALE and PERIOD changed while running
details: Not double-buffered and stated as not defined [N-7.1a]. For a motor output the minimum to show is that no pin is ever stuck high and that the outputs return to the programmed waveform within one frame. Found here - a PRESCALE lowered below the running prescaler count stalled the time base for up to 65536 cycles with the pins frozen. Fixed, erratum PWM-4.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: no check. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: cg_pwm_cfg.cp_change_running
details: PERIOD lowered below the counter, raised, and PRESCALE changed, each with EN set.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: a_no_stuck_high
details: With a legal duty below PERIOD no pin stays high longer than one frame.
implementation_note: sb_no_stuck_high in the scoreboard (whole high time of every pin, whatever is written meanwhile) and a_tick_no_stall in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv. Passing after the fix for erratum PWM-4, which this check found.

NAME: D Safe states
details: Spec 7.4, 7.5, 9. Low beats everything.

NAME: F18 Outputs are low in reset before enable and when disabled
details: Low unless EN and the channel enable are both set. Requirement R-6, spec [N-6.1], [N-9.2].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-6], [N-9.2], and a whole-run monitor for [N-6.1]. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: a_low_when_off
details: A pin is 0 in every cycle in which reset is active, EN is 0 or its channel enable is 0.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: F19 Clearing EN drives all four outputs low in the same cycle
details: Combinational, not at the end of the frame. Clearing one channel enable does the same for that channel. Spec [N-7.5].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [N-7.5]. Now: all 2 items passing.

NAME: a_low_when_off
details: Covered by F18.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_pwm_stop.cp_stop_phase
details: EN cleared while high, while low, in the boundary cycle; each channel enable cleared while its pin is high.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: F20 Re-enabling starts a clean frame
details: After EN is set again the first pulse has the programmed width; there is no runt from a counter left mid-frame.
implementation_note: Method: sim. Before the UVM environment: no check. Now: all 1 items passing.

NAME: sb_no_runt
details: First pulse after every enable measured.
implementation_note: pwm_scoreboard, measured on the pins without the model's cycle state - 41363 frames and 38176 pulses in 22 runs, 0 mismatches.

NAME: F21 A duty wider than the period is clamped and reported
details: The shadow is clamped to PERIOD, STATUS bit 16 + n is set and IRQSTAT bit 1 is raised; the flag clears by itself at the next boundary once the duty is legal. Requirement R-7, spec [N-7.4].
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-7], [N-7.4]. Now: all 3 items passing.

NAME: a_clamp
details: A shadow duty never exceeds PERIOD.
implementation_note: SVA in rtl/pwm/pwm_sva.sv, bound to garuda_pwm_top. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, the directed bench and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: sb_status
details: Clamp flags compared with the model.
implementation_note: pwm_scoreboard in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv, against pwm_ref_model. 0 mismatches in 22 runs.

NAME: cg_pwm_clamp.x_ch_amount
details: Each channel clamped; duty PERIOD + 1 and 0xFFFF; two and four channels clamped together.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.

NAME: E Interrupt
details: Spec section 6, requirement R-9.

NAME: F22 Period-boundary and clamp events are captured and held
details: IRQSTAT bit 0 at every period boundary, bit 1 on a clamp. irq_o is the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN, a level held until written 1 to clear. A new event in the cycle of the clear is not lost. Decision D-17.
implementation_note: Method: sim + formal. Before the UVM environment: tb_pwm [R-9] for the clamp event. Now: all 3 items passing.

NAME: a_irq_level
details: irq_o equals the OR of IRQSTAT and IRQEN in every cycle.
implementation_note: SVA a_shim_irq_level in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the shim of every peripheral. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, six block benches and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: a_set_beats_clear
details: An event in the cycle of its own clear leaves the bit set.
implementation_note: SVA a_shim_set_beats_clear in rtl/common/garuda_apb_shim_sva.sv, bound to the shim of every peripheral. Passing in the 22 UVM runs, six block benches and the chip tests; seen to trigger. Also a formal property - waiting for JasperGold.

NAME: cg_pwm_irq.x_src_en
details: Each source with its enable 0 and 1; clear in the event cycle.
implementation_note: pwm_coverage in tb/pwm/uvm/pwm_env_pkg.sv. 100 percent in the merged 22 runs.
